Inside Macintosh: Mac OS 8 Human Interface Guidelines /

Chapter 3 - Dialog Box Guidelines

This chapter describes the dialog boxes that your application can use and shows how each has changed under platinum appearance. The chapter gives brief recommendations on choosing and implementing each kind of dialog box; more details are available in Macintosh Human Interface Guidelines. Finally, the chapter provides guidelines on how to lay out dialog boxes and alert boxes for maximum clarity and consistency under any appearance settings.
